name: 5F-MPMI
summary: 5-Fluoro-MPMI, also known as 5F-MPMI or 5-F-MPMI, is a pyrrolidinylmethylindole and cyclized tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist, selective for the 5-HT2 subtypes but with similar affinity to all three receptors, having strongest activity at 5-HT2B and weakest at 5-HT2A.

pharmacology.text: 5-Fluoro-MPMI, also known as 5F-MPMI or 5-F-MPMI, is a pyrrolidinylmethylindole and cyclized tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist, selective for the 5-HT2 subtypes but with similar affinity to all three receptors, having strongest activity at 5-HT2B and weakest at 5-HT2A.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is known from laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它出現在血清素受體的實驗室研究中。
uses.zhHans: 它出现在血清素受体的实验室研究中。

fact.en: Despite being grouped with the synthetic cannabinoids, it is in fact a cyclised tryptamine that acts on serotonin receptors, not on cannabinoid receptors.
fact.zh: 雖然它常被歸在合成大麻素之中，實際上它是一種環化色胺，作用於血清素受體，而不是大麻素受體。
fact.zhHans: 虽然它常被归在合成大麻素之中，实际上它是一种环化色胺，作用于血清素受体，而不是大麻素受体。
